title: RADIHALT EMF Evidence Source Index
description: RADIHALT Research maintains this open, reviewed directory to make the evidence behind RADIHALT's EMF education easy to inspect, cite, and reuse. It spans regulators, national standards, precautionary frameworks, research bodies, classifications, physician guidance, and studies. Every record supplies an evidence role, original reference, primary URL, and permanent RADIHALT guide URL. The included methodology defines the scope of this evidence-discovery resource; it is not a systematic review or medical advice.
